note: Budgets with ~15% headroom over measured values. Initial JS (entry + modulepreloads in index.html) was 76.5 kB raw / 28.6 kB gzip on 2026-11-03 after splitting module screens into on-demand chunks (single bundle before: 153.3 kB / 51.1 kB). Totals sum every chunk compressed separately, so splitting adds per-file gzip overhead; total JS gzip was raised from 60 kB to 70 kB for that reason and for the navigation shell (+~5 kB gzip). Raise only with justification in the PR.
